summary: Iteration 99: Buy Planning Phase A UI Enhancements - All features verified. Store Wedge tab: distribution cards (30 total, 17 A, 9 B, 4 C), search/filter, Type column with Auto/Manual badges. Style Mix tab: search filter, style count (20 styles). Attribution tab: detail panel opens on row click with wedge allocation bars and coverage. Config tab: impact indicators (Balanced/Aggressive/Conservative), Impact Summary panel, Example Calculation with live values.

TEST_01_distribution_cards_present.notes: Total Stores, A-Stores, B-Stores, C-Stores cards visible

TEST_11_empty_state_filter_message.notes: Shows 'No stores match your filters' when search has no results

TEST_18_panel_shows_style_info.notes: Panel shows Style, Style Mix, SKU Count, Eligible Stores

TEST_19_panel_shows_wedge_allocation.notes: Panel shows Wedge Allocation with bars for A/B/C stores

TEST_22_row_click_toggles_panel.notes: Clicking same row toggles panel visibility

TEST_24_impact_indicators_balanced.notes: 6 Balanced indicators visible for default values

TEST_25_impact_summary_panel.notes: Impact Summary panel present on right side

TEST_27_example_calc_live_values.notes: Shows Forecast: 100 units, Current Stock: 20 units, Core Multiplier: 1.2x

TEST_28_aggressive_indicator.notes: Setting Core to 1.5 shows Aggressive indicator

TEST_29_save_button_appears.notes: Save button appears when value is edited

TEST_33_tab_switching.notes: All tabs (Assortment Matrix, Buy Plan, DNA Tags, etc.) switch correctly

TEST_34_override_modal.notes: data-testid=override-modal opens on edit button click

issues: Console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' - React hydration warning in select options. Minor issue, does not affect functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: Store Wedge tab correctly shows distribution summary cards with Total (30), A (17), B (9), C (4) with progress bars
Store Wedge search (data-testid=store-search-input) filters by store ID, name, or city correctly
Store Wedge filter dropdown (data-testid=store-wedge-filter) filters by A/B/C wedge correctly
Store Wedge Type column shows Auto/Manual classification badges
Store Wedge empty state message changes based on filter vs no data
Style Mix search (data-testid=style-search-input) filters styles by name correctly
Style Mix shows style count (20 styles) next to search
Attribution row click opens detail panel (data-testid=attribution-detail-panel) on the right
Attribution detail panel shows style info, wedge allocation bars, coverage percentage
Attribution clicking same row or close button hides detail panel
Config tab shows impact indicators (Balanced/Aggressive/Conservative) per multiplier card
Config Impact Summary panel shows per-style assessment on right side
Config Example Calculation (data-testid=config-example-calc) shows live values that update with multiplier changes
Config editing Core to 1.5 correctly shows Aggressive indicator in real-time
All existing functionality (Override modal, CSV export, classify buttons, tab switching) still works
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Tests used existing sample data (30 stores: 17 A, 9 B, 4 C; 20 Core styles).
